content.text:
## 1. First 5 sections (`content/config/homepage.json`)

| # | id | type |
|---|-----|------|
| 1 | `hero` | `hero` |
| 2 | `trust-bar` | `trustBar` |
| 3 | `stats` | `stats` |
| 4 | `services` | `services` |
| 5 | `creative-showcase` | `creativeShowcase` |

Stats is immediately after Trust bar (matches B3 placement lock).

---

## 2. Stats `data` object (full)

From `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\content\config\homepage.json` (lines 244–266):

```json
{
  "items": [
    { "value": "$112M+", "label": "Revenue managed" },
    { "value": "95%", "label": "Client retention" },
    { "value": "20+", "label": "In-house specialists" },
    { "value": "2018", "label": "Helping sellers since" }
  ]
}
```

Same four claims also live in `content/config/site.json` → `claims` (`revenueManaged`, `retention`, `teamSize`, `since`).

---

## 3. Implementation (`stats-section`)

**Path:** `e:\Desktop\Projects\ecomGliders\src\components\sections\stats-section.tsx`  
**Wired by:** `homepage-section-renderer.tsx` when `type === "stats"` → `<StatsSection id={section.id} data={section.data} />`

**Props:** `{ id: string; data: Record<string, unknown> }` — reads `data.items` via `readRecordArray`; each item needs `value` + `label`.

**Layout:**
- `SectionShell` with `py-10 sm:py-12`
- `<ul>` grid: 1 col → `sm:grid-cols-2` → `lg:grid-cols-4`
- Each item: bordered `rounded-md` cell, `shadow-sm`, top accent bar (`h-1 bg-accent`), `text-stat text-accent-alt` for value, `text-small` secondary label
- No heading/eyebrow; no count-up animation

**vs B3:** Plan wants quieter cells (less dashboard-card). Current UI still uses border + shadow + accent strip.

---

## 4. Part B3 plan summary

Source: `.cursor/plans/homepage_landing_audit_0b7e065e.plan.md` § **B3. Stats — LOCKED**

| | |
|--|--|
| **Goal** | Tight 4-metric proof strip under trust (AMZ Dudes “proof in the numbers”); mobile 2×2 → desktop 4-up; no counters in v1 |
| **Decision** | Keep exactly these four; stay after Trust; optional quiet eyebrow or none (prefer none); no count-up; quiet cells; no trust-bar `$112M+` duplicate (B2) |
| **Gaps / open polish** | Soften card-heavy look; ensure trust→stats contrast rhythm; a11y list semantics; no fifth vanity metric |
| **Reject** | Old-site “Client success isn’t a goal…”; fake ACOS/ROI; mimicking $10B peers |
| **Out of scope** | Win ticker, case metrics (B7), footer stats repeat |

Status in plan todos: **Section 3 Stats — LOCKED**.

---

## 5. Competitor notes on stats/metrics strips

**`docs/seo/COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md`:**
- **AMZ Dudes:** Stat cards immediately below hero (`$50M+`, ACoS cut, ROI) — adopt early proof strip
- **Olifant:** Scrolling revenue ticker — skip (motion noise; no per-win feed)
- **Canopy:** Repeated footer/stats — single placement only this phase
- **SalesDuo:** `$3B+` / `300+ brands` scale strip — reference only; do not inflate
- **Honest table:** eCG `$112M+` / `95%` / `20+` / `2018` vs peers’ `$B` scale — present honestly; 95% competitive; `$112M` credible mid-market
- **Adopt:** “Stat cards above fold (AMZ Dudes)”; **Avoid:** inflating metrics to enterprise scale

**`docs/research/HERO-COMPETITOR-UI-AUDIT-2026-09-03.md`:** Keep trust bar + stats under hero; prefer verified overlays only.

**`docs/research/HEADER-NAV-RIBBON-CTA-2026-09-02.md`:** Ribbon can keep Verified Partner + `$112M+` + `95%` (separate from section Stats).

---

## 6. Verified metrics status

| Metric | Where used (Stats) | Documented as verified? |
|--------|--------------------|-------------------------|
| `$112M+` revenue managed | Stats item 1 | Yes — project rule 13, `obsidian/09-Research/Current-Site-Audit.md`, B3 (“Verified as company claims used site-wide”), FAQ answer cites “verified company claims from the current site” |
| `95%` client retention | Stats item 2 | Same |
| `20+` in-house specialists | Stats item 3 | Same |
| `2018` / helping sellers since | Stats item 4 (value `2018`, label “Helping sellers since”); also hero `trustLine` | Same |

**Evidence language note:** “Verified” here means **canonical company claims from the live/old site and project docs**, not third-party financial audit. Rule text: *verify before reusing*; B3 confidence: High for claims-as-used-site-wide. Do not invent extra % metrics.
